title: Active Network Diagnostics
desc: Opt-in probes: ICMP/UDP Ping, Multi-Transport Traceroute, and Bandwidth-Constrained Bufferbloat Testing.
empty: Enter a target hostname or IP address (IPv4, IPv6, domain) and choose a diagnostic probe.
invalid_target: Please enter a valid target hostname, IPv4, IPv6, or localhost address.

full_analysis.title: Full Analysis
full_analysis.subtitle: Multi-Stage Inference
full_analysis.desc: Executes Gateway, DNS, Latency, Traceroute, Bufferbloat, and HTTP probes to synthesize deterministic root-cause findings.

ping.title: Ping Probe
ping.subtitle: ICMP / UDP Telemetry
ping.desc: Measures round-trip time (RTT), latency jitter, and packet loss percentage over sequential sample bursts.

traceroute.title: Traceroute
traceroute.subtitle: Multi-Transport Lineage
traceroute.desc: Traces the exact hop-by-hop intermediate router path to the destination with per-hop latency and reverse DNS resolution.

bufferbloat.title: Bufferbloat Test
bufferbloat.subtitle: Loaded Latency Grading
bufferbloat.desc: Evaluates queueing delay and latency bloat under simulated bandwidth saturation, assigning an A+ to F performance scorecard.

assessment.title: Diagnostic Assessment & Findings
assessment.no_bottleneck_desc: All diagnostic probes operated within nominal parameters. Available evidence did not establish an active bottleneck.

dns.title: Check DNS Resolver Configuration
dns.desc: Verify primary and secondary DNS server addresses. Test using reliable public resolvers (such as 1.1.1.1 or 8.8.8.8) to isolate provider resolver slowdowns.
dns.description: Verify primary and secondary DNS server addresses. Test using reliable public resolvers (such as 1.1.1.1 or 8.8.8.8) to isolate provider resolver slowdowns.

gateway.title: Inspect Local Router & Gateway Connection
gateway.desc: Check physical cable connections or Wi-Fi signal strength to your local router/gateway. Restart the local router if the default route remains unreachable.
gateway.description: Check physical cable connections or Wi-Fi signal strength to your local router/gateway. Restart the local router if the default route remains unreachable.

bufferbloat.title: Enable Smart Queue Management (SQM)
bufferbloat.desc: Configure modern queue management (such as CAKE or fq_codel) on your router to prevent latency spikes during high-throughput downloads or uploads.
bufferbloat.description: Configure modern queue management (such as CAKE or fq_codel) on your router to prevent latency spikes during high-throughput downloads or uploads.

loss.title: Isolate Packet Loss Location
loss.desc: Run continuous ping against your local gateway first. If gateway loss is 0%, contact your Internet Service Provider to investigate upstream packet drops.
loss.description: Run continuous ping against your local gateway first. If gateway loss is 0%, contact your Internet Service Provider to investigate upstream packet drops.

http.title: Verify Remote Server Status
http.desc: The remote application server is experiencing errors or high latency. Check status pages or contact the service administrator to determine if an outage is underway.
http.description: The remote application server is experiencing errors or high latency. Check status pages or contact the service administrator to determine if an outage is underway.

routing.title: Monitor Route Stability
routing.desc: An extended or suboptimal routing path was detected. If persistent, check if a VPN or proxy is causing traffic hair-pinning.
routing.description: An extended or suboptimal routing path was detected. If persistent, check if a VPN or proxy is causing traffic hair-pinning.

nominal.title: Network Operating Nominally
nominal.desc: No remedial actions required. Continue monitoring traffic for transient anomalies.
nominal.description: No remedial actions required. Continue monitoring traffic for transient anomalies.
